temporalApplicability.pre2020Rule: Apply the same evidence tiers and promotion gates. Record source-access gaps by era; do not interpret missing web archives as no mandate.

purpose: Trace disclosed institutional-LP allocations through selected managers and vehicles to verified CRE deployments without treating untraced capital as available dry powder.

evidenceLayers.storage: live authority DB plus approved manifest
evidenceLayers.rule: The promoted claim itself must cite at least one official or transaction-party primary notice, result, disclosure, filing, API record, legal document, report or press release. News may remain as corroboration but cannot be the only evidence.

Retain article, research-report, search-snippet and industry-rumor claims as a verification queue with exact wording, source URL, dates and the missing official evidence. Never present them as established selections, commitments or deployments.
Do not delete the record. Preserve rejection reason, contradicting source and supersession relation so the same claim is not repeatedly rediscovered.

promotionRules: An article claim later matched to an official disclosure is promoted using the official claim as canonical evidence; the article remains corroborating provenance.
A news-only manager, amount, vehicle or deal link remains a verification candidate even when repeated by syndicated articles.
Two articles copied from one press release are one document family, not independent verification.
Promotion is claim-level: an official RFP can verify a mandate and guideline without verifying the manager result.
Every candidate records verification_needed, last_checked_at, source_family and resolution_status.

likelyInformationRule.purpose: Do not leave best-available fields blank when a concrete, plausible secondary claim exists; expose it with an explicit non-canonical status.

statuses.LIKELY_REPORTED_PENDING_PRIMARY: A matching official recruitment/plan exists and at least one reputable full-text report gives concrete manager, date, amount or strategy details without contradiction.
statuses.HIGHLY_LIKELY_REPORTED_PENDING_PRIMARY: The likely criteria are met and at least two genuinely independent source families report materially consistent details.

likelyInformationRule.sourceFamilyRule: Repeated or syndicated copies from one source family increase visibility but count as one evidentiary family. Independent-family count, article count and raw occurrence count are stored separately.
likelyInformationRule.projectionRule: Keep canonical value null when unverified, but populate best_available_value with value_status, confidence, independent_family_count, occurrence_count and verification_needed.
likelyInformationRule.liveRule: Likely values may enter the relational verification layer and user-facing best-available projections, but never lp_mandate_selections, commitment balances or deal deployments before primary verification.

amountBases.SELECTION_LP_COMMITMENT: 특정 선정 운용사에 귀속된 검증된 LP 배정·약정액
amountBases.TARGET_FUND_SIZE: LP 출자액과 구분되는 목표 펀드 결성 규모

returnRules: gross와 net을 구분하고 불명확하면 UNSPECIFIED로 둔다.
요구수익률 비공개를 0 또는 시장 관행 수치로 대체하지 않는다.
deploymentApprovalRule: Manager-name equality alone is insufficient. Approve mandate-to-deal deployment only when vehicle, investment timing, amount or explicit source wording supports the edge.

balanceRule.formula: verified exact ALLOCATION_PER_MANAGER or SELECTION_LP_COMMITMENT - verified exact LP_SOURCE_DEPLOYMENT

unknownRule: Unpublished applicants, shortlist, commitment, capital call, paid-in amount, deployment and residual source remain UNKNOWN; do not infer.
candidateRetentionRule: Unverified information is separated from canonical live data, not discarded. Preserve it as a dated verification candidate until promoted, contradicted, withdrawn, rejected or explicitly left unresolved.
